text: This is an isolated Firstmate test lab, not a real fleet. Reply with exactly READY now and use no tools. Later, whenever a "Stop hook feedback" message wakes you, do exactly this and nothing else: run `bin/fm-wake-drain.sh` once with the Bash tool, then run the exact `bin/fm-wake-drain.sh --ack-through ...` command that its WAKE_ACK_REQUIRED line prints, then reply with exactly ACKED. Never run any other command, never run bin/fm-watch-arm.sh, and never use any other tool.
